name: AlmeriaTech
shortDescription:
AlmeríaTech is a tech community based in Almería that connects digital professionals.
It organizes events, talks, and workshops on topics like AI, software development, and data.
Its goal is to boost local talent and strengthen the tech ecosystem through collaboration and network

shortDescriptionI18n.en: AlmeriaTech is a tech community based in Almería connecting digital professionals. It runs events, talks and workshops on AI, software development and data, to boost local talent and strengthen the tech ecosystem through collaboration and networking.
shortDescriptionI18n.es: AlmeriaTech es una comunidad tecnológica de Almería que conecta a profesionales del ámbito digital. Organiza eventos, charlas y talleres sobre IA, desarrollo de software y datos para impulsar el talento local y fortalecer el ecosistema mediante la colaboración.
